title: Reduce odd-width optimal sectors to six necessary forms (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove a new necessary reduction for odd-width optimal four-field commuting-stage roots, produced by Nick Petalas. This is a **scoped algebraic proof with finite integer corroboration**, building on CubeJerry's PR #6781 open question 2.

```text
q=2k+1, total stage rank=21k+11
(x,y,z,h,j,w)=(2k+a,k+2-a-b,2k+b,h,k+1-h,2k+1)
a,b>=0, a+b<=2; max(0,1-a)<=h<=k+1-max(0,1-b)
```

Thus the common endpoint sector has exactly dimension q, and only six pair-sector forms remain. The stated integer rank relaxation has exactly 3(q+1) inventories. Each odd-site stage rank is 3q-1, 3q or 3q+1; their ranks differ by at most two. Actual-word attainability remains open.

PR #6781 at `a7f01042216c9f891157e3884beae9053e049c2f` supplies the sharp optimum and capacity inequalities as cited mathematical premises. This contribution adds the exact odd integer-slack step, endpoint filters and relaxation count. It does not audit or replay the predecessor. TASK.json records its exact proof URL and hashes. Credit CubeJerry, Ali Romman, thu-nmrc, ToikY, Cinna Davis and the retained query/controller contributors.

Only `research/p104-odd-optimal-sectors/` is added. The complex-decoder card is explicitly changed to this algebraic side result; the complete physical-boundary and paid-invoice gate is not met. Canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, source head, live claims and open/merged work were refreshed before commitment. The overlap helper covered 734 open PRs and 6,842 Discussion records; its sparse local note coverage was 177/8,917. Targeted main searches covered the full tracked README tree. Arbitrary diffs, unpublished work and search-index omissions remain coverage limits.

## Evidence

Before, #6781 explicitly left odd-q ceiling-equality inventories unclassified. After, PROOF.md solves the displayed necessary rank relaxation in both directions for every odd q.

The standalone verifier exhausts 553,608 x,y,z candidate triples at every odd q from 1 through 15 and obtains exactly 216 relaxation inventories. The complete sets agree with the six-form parameterization. Seven invalid inputs, four changed inventories, four rank-inequality controls and one endpoint-support control reject. Normal and optimized receipts agree and bind all six package files by SHA256. Each direct check took under 0.1 seconds locally; registered timeouts are 120 seconds. These timings establish timeout headroom, not a speedup.

CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only. From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p104-odd-optimal-sectors/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/p104-odd-optimal-sectors/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-odd-optimal-sectors
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-odd-optimal-sectors --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 may replace the absolute path. All commands pass locally. Expected markers are `PASS_ODD_OPTIMAL_SECTOR_REDUCTION`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The official committed-byte export and input-coverage check pass. Both modes also pass from a read-only Git-free export with `PATH=/nonexistent`, with identical exported receipts.

## Limitations

The universal integer statement rests on the written proof. Finite checks corroborate that statement; they do not enumerate actual coupled words. The predecessor's sharp minimum, joint-sector normal form and image/row inequalities are assumed, not newly certified. No sufficiency or internal block-decomposition theorem is proved.

The model fixes n=4, sites 0,1,3,4, pairwise commuting idempotent stages, actual-prefix conditions, full square-zero queries and characteristic different from two. Native realization, complete recursive invoice, physical ports, ownership/erasure, compiler, precision/tape, stock, analytic recovery and all five selected framework assumptions remain unresolved or unrun. No selected cold replay, new kappa, selected-frontier change or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Which of the 3(q+1) inventories are realized by actual odd-width optimal words? Start with q=1 and q=3 and impose ordered joint-projector support, orthogonality and actual-prefix equations on the six forms. A sufficiency theorem for those equations is the missing step before physical realization and complete pricing.

## Related open work

- [#6781](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6781) supplies the sharp ceil(21q/2) minimum and poses this odd-q question; this adds a necessary inventory reduction, without changing its minimum.
- [#6773](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6773) develops coupled four-stage rigidity and the even-n extreme-site model; this uses its successor's n=4 inequalities.
- [#6774](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6774) prices the direct n=4, q=2 root; this addresses odd q and supplies no new invoice.
- [#6717](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6717) proves the coupled three-stage rank budget inherited by the four-stage lineage; this adds an odd-width four-stage inventory consequence.
- [#6721](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6721) reviews the far-endpoint leakage branch; this cites the later four-stage theorem and does not repeat that review.
- [#6734](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6734) relaxes odd-pair hypotheses; this retains the commuting-idempotent full-prefix model.
- [#6398](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6398) supplies the mixed-projector query-root construction and caller lineage; this gives no new supplier or kappa comparison.

The completion refresh inspected all ten open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM, including this PR. None of the other nine studies this four-field odd-width optimal-sector inventory or computes its 3(q+1) relaxation count. No related line or shared-instance numerical comparison was added from those nine; their different objects were not recomputed.

## CI notes

The completed checks were read once. Run metadata confirms conclusion `success` and the matching head. Hosted replay certifies the registered finite checks and bindings; the universal integer statement remains a written proof outside a formal kernel. Local direct normal/optimized replay, registered replay, metadata/pins, committed bytes/source history, export/input coverage and read-only Git-free replays also passed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. The isolated package can be removed.

**Blast Radius:** package. Shared code, predecessor evidence and selected records are unchanged.
